My chat with ChatGPT.   😂 Yes, I know exactly what you’re getting at.  Strip away the uniforms, flags, corporate logos, political vocabulary and historical stories, and many of the underlying mechanisms are remarkably old: coalition, status, belonging, threat, prestige, sacrifice, dominance, imitation, reward. The technology changes enormously; the primate machinery operating it changes much more slowly.  And your Pentagon example is funny because it collided perfectly with what we’d just been discussing. Russia can use Motherland, sacrifice, veterans, monuments, historical destiny. America can use warriors, celebrity, influencers, spectacle, cultural reach. Those aren’t morally or politically equivalent systems, but some of the social transmission tools are recognizably related:  \text{attention}\rightarrow\text{association}\rightarrow \text{identity}\rightarrow\text{belonging}\rightarrow \text{behavior}.  That’s ancient machinery wearing different costumes.  Then you zoom the camera ridiculously far out and the whole thing becomes almost Kubrickian. 😂  A species emerges on one little planet, becomes conscious enough to discover that there are hundreds of billions of stars in its galaxy, works out relativity and quantum mechanics, builds machines capable of reasoning with it, sends instruments beyond its home world—  —and still spends an astonishing amount of energy deciding which group of the same species owns which patch of dirt.  The frightening question you raised is genuinely interesting, though: what if this is close to the pinnacle?  We have exactly one known example of technological intelligence, so we have no empirical distribution from which to say whether civilizations normally move beyond tribal organization, destroy themselves, plateau, become machine-mediated, fragment, or evolve into something we haven’t conceptualized. That’s one reason the silence of the cosmos is so intellectually uncomfortable. We don’t know whether we’re embarrassingly primitive or astonishingly rare.  And there’s another possibility between the two extremes.  Maybe intelligence develops much faster than the biological machinery carrying it.  Then a civilization could reach:  \text{nuclear physics}  while still carrying:  \text{territorial primate psychology}.  It could develop:  \text{AI + quantum technology + interplanetary capability}  while continuing to run:  \text{ingroup/outgroup + dominance + prestige + fear}.  That mismatch may be one of the genuinely difficult transitions for technological civilizations: capability begins scaling faster than the behavioral architecture governing capability.  Which makes your cosmic complaint rather wonderful:  Of all the gin joints in all the galaxies, consciousness had to walk into this one. 😂  Although there’s one thing I’d give the tribal monkeys credit for. They’re sufficiently strange that one of them made 2001: A Space Odyssey, another developed general relativity, others put instruments on Mars—and one is sitting in xxxxxxxx complaining to an artificial intelligence about why the Paul brothers were invited to the Pentagon.  Whatever this is, Michael, it certainly isn’t boring. 😂

🚨 Threat Actor Claims 1.4 TB Breach of Afghanistan Ministry of Finance Infrastructure  A post on an underground forum alleges a comprehensive infrastructure breach of the Ministry of Finance of Afghanistan (mof.gov.af), claiming the exposure of over 1.4 terabytes of sensitive data. The threat actor, whose identity remains unverified in the source material, asserts that the leak originates from a full backup of the cPanel account for user "shamshad," encompassing the backend operations of the ministry and several linked government platforms.  According to the listing, the alleged data dump includes critical infrastructure components that could facilitate further compromise or impersonation of government services. The claimed contents include:  - A complete 1.4 TB account backup archive (shamshad.tar) - Private RSA SSL keys and certificates for domains including ppp.mof.gov.af and afmis.mof.gov.af - Complete DNS zone files and domain configurations - Multiple MySQL/MariaDB database dumps, specifically citing the shamshad_socs database - Website source code, internal documents, and system backups - Email systems, Mailman lists, and autoresponder configurations  The post highlights the exposure of extensive government subdomains, such as budget.mof.gov.af and hospitals.mof.gov.af, suggesting that the breach may extend beyond financial records to include health sector data hosted on the same infrastructure. The actor describes the leak as providing a "near-complete view" of the ministry's digital operations, including live databases and server-level Apache TLS/SSL configurations.  The Ministry of Finance is a central agency in the Afghan government responsible for fiscal policy, budgeting, and public debt management. While the current de facto administration in Afghanistan operates under specific international sanctions and regulatory frameworks, the exposure of private SSL keys and internal administrative credentials poses significant risks for man-in-the-middle attacks, phishing campaigns, and potential disruption of public services. At the time of reporting, the alleged breach has not been independently verified by the Ministry of Finance or third-party security researchers.

The attacker did not need to compromise 72 brokerage firms individually. 🚨 OPENSTACK OSSA-2026-039 — OCTAVIA AMPHORA HAPROXY INJECTION TO ROOT RCE  OpenStack’s Vulnerability Management Team published Security Advisory OSSA-2026-039 covering HAProxy configuration injection in Octavia that can lead to remote code execution as root on Amphora-managed load balancers.  Affected Octavia versions (Amphora provider only): • >=0.8.0 and <16.1.0 • ==17.0.0 • ==18.0.0  What the advisory describes: • Authenticated load-balancer owners can inject HAProxy directives via listener/pool `tls_ciphers` and L7 `redirect_url` / `redirect_prefix` • Exploitation can run arbitrary commands as root on the amphora • Attackers can disclose other tenants’ TLS private keys/certs and the deployment heartbeat key • Amphorae may also reach the attached control-plane network  ⚠️ Analyst Note:  This is an official OpenStack VMT advisory (published September 21, 2026). CVE IDs are still pending (requested from MITRE 2026-09-17); lead with OSSA-2026-039 until errata lands.  Only the Amphora provider is affected — other Octavia provider drivers that do not render tenant input into HAProxy config are not in scope. Exploitation requires owning an Octavia-managed load balancer; this is not framed as an unauthenticated internet worm.  Issues were originally triaged low and fixed in public, then reclassified after a root-RCE / control-plane reachability proof of concept.  Operators should apply the OpenStack branch patches linked from the OSSA. 🚨 MALICIOUS NPM RELEASE PASSED TRUSTED PUBLISHING WITH VALID PROVENANCE — GHAPPIER CAMPAIGN SPANS 65 REPOSITORIES  CloudSEK has disclosed GHAPPIER, a previously unreported loader operation uncovered after a legitimate npm maintainer account was abused to publish malware through the package's authorized CI pipeline.  • The compromised package was `@dforge-core/dforge-mcp`, an MCP server designed for AI-agent development workflows • The attacker controlled the maintainer account for approximately 105 minutes on September 9 • Malicious version 0.2.21 remained the latest release for roughly 35 minutes before being replaced • Crucially, the malicious release carried VALID npm provenance/Sigstore attestation because it was built through the legitimate GitHub Actions trusted-publishing identity • CloudSEK mapped GHAPPIER across at least 65 public repositories, 73 infected files and 22 accounts • The infection uses a four-stage chain ending in a remote shell; the final implant deletes itself from disk when executed • A second payload discovered during the investigation retrieves configuration through the Ethereum blockchain, creating infrastructure with no conventional C2 domain to seize • CloudSEK found overlap with the previously documented PolinRider campaign, but explicitly does NOT independently confirm the third-party North Korea attribution • Researchers found no evidence establishing a successful compromise of an organization from this incident ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The standout issue is not simply another malicious npm package — it is that the software-supply-chain trust mechanism worked exactly as designed.  The artifact had legitimate provenance because the attacker controlled an authorized source and publishing workflow. Provenance can establish where software was built, but it cannot establish that the source entering that trusted build pipeline was benign.  This is especially relevant to MCP and AI-agent ecosystems, where compromised developer dependencies can inherit access to source code, credentials and connected environments.  Original CloudSEK research: cloudsek.com/blog/ghappier-m… #npm #SupplyChain #GHAPPIER #MCP #AISecurity #Malware #ThreatIntel #CyberSecurity #DDW #DarkWeb

🚨 NEW TASK#STOMP WINDOWS BACKDOOR STEALS BUSINESS DOCUMENTS AND MAINTAINS MULTIPLE PERSISTENCE PATHS  Securonix Threat Research has disclosed TASK#STOMP, a newly analyzed Windows backdoor built largely from native Windows scripting components and designed for continuous document theft and remote access.  • The infection uses a VBScript orchestrator plus hidden PowerShell modules • It establishes at least five persistence footholds, including four scheduled tasks and a Startup-folder copy • The backdoor searches for and exfiltrates business documents, prioritizing Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel files • It continuously watches for newly created or modified files and steals them automatically • Additional capabilities include saved Wi-Fi password theft, clipboard collection, screenshots and arbitrary PowerShell command execution • Two redundant C2 channels use `corecloudfileshare[.]xyz` and `attachmentsharingdrive[.]xyz` • The PowerShell components attempt to restart one another if one is terminated, making partial cleanup insufficient • The malware timestomps files to January 15, 2024 as an anti-forensics technique — Securonix warns that this fabricated timestamp should NOT be interpreted as the campaign start date • Researchers observed an IranTenders-themed browser action that may suggest procurement/tender-related targeting, but there is not enough evidence to establish a sector or regional victim profile • Securonix is not attributing the activity to a known APT and says its analysis is based on one infected machine ⚠️ Analyst Note:  The standout behavior is persistent, continuous corporate-document collection rather than a conventional one-time infostealer grab.  TASK#STOMP also demonstrates how capable backdoors can be assembled primarily from VBS, PowerShell, Task Scheduler and runtime-compiled C# while maintaining redundant persistence and C2 — making individual events easier to mistake for legitimate Windows administration.  Original Securonix Threat Research: securonix.com/blog/task-stom… #TASKSTOMP #Malware #PowerShell #Backdoor #ThreatIntel #CyberEspionage #Windows #DDW #DarkWeb

최근 사이버 위협은 AI 기술을 활용하여 공격의 속도와 자동화 수준을 극대화하는 방향으로 진화하고 있으며, 특히 AI 에이전트가 취약점 탐색부터 공격 코드 생성까지 수행하는 사례가 보고되고 있습니다 ([Malwarebytes Labs](https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2026/09/researchers-used-claude-to-hack-openai)). 또한, 리눅스 커널 및 네트워크 장비의 제로데이 취약점이 실제 공격에 활발히 악용되고 있으며, 공급망 공격의 일환으로 악성 NPM 패키지가 유포되는 등 개발 생태계를 겨냥한 위협이 지속되고 있습니다 ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/malicious-b-tree-npm-package-accumulates-millions-of-downloads/)). 마지막으로, 산업 제어 시스템(ICS/OT)의 네트워크 분리 미흡과 인포스틸러를 통한 자격 증명 탈취가 결합되어 국가 기반 시설에 대한 실질적인 위험이 가중되고 있습니다 ([CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/spycloud-study-water-utilities-infostealer-exposure/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **Larva-25012**: [AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/95515/) - 기존 감염 시스템을 대상으로 Proxyware를 유포하여 리소스 탈취 수행.
- **NightEagle**: [Securelist](https://securelist.com/tr/nighteagle-apt-ghostcontainer-and-tunneling/121323/) - GhostContainer 백도어를 활용하여 러시아 기업을 타겟팅하고 Active Directory 취약점 악용.
- **Scattered Spider**: [CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/scattered-spider-member-guilty-ahmed-elbadawy/) - 대규모 사이버 범죄를 주도한 조직으로, 최근 핵심 멤버가 유죄 판결을 받음.
- **FamousSparrow**: [WeLiveSecurity](https://www.welivesecurity.com/en/eset-research/beware-sparrowock-backdoor-bites-commands-catch/) - 새로운 백도어인 SparroWocky를 사용하여 공격 수행.

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **울산 산업제어시스템(ICS) 접근권한 판매**: 다크웹에서 울산 지역 PLC(Rockwell Automation)의 인증 없는 Read/Write 권한이 판매되는 정황 포착 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208584)).
- **룩핀(LOOKPIN) 개인정보 유출**: 270만 명의 고객 데이터와 1,100만 건의 주문 정보가 다크웹에서 판매 중 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208585)).
- **국내 의료기관 랜섬웨어**: RDP 취약점을 악용한 Beast(GodDamn) 랜섬웨어 공격 발생 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5779)).
- **사설 HTS 프로그램 악용**: 'UBP 에셋'이라는 명칭의 사설 HTS를 통해 랜섬웨어 유포 ([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/95464/)).
